description: This header file declares network-related functions and structures for the Lighttpd server, including socket initialization, registration, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: network_accept_tcp_nagle_disable
methods.description: Disables Nagle's algorithm for TCP socket identified by file descriptor.

methods.name: network_init
methods.description: Initializes network components for the server, setting up necessary sockets and configurations.

methods.name: network_close
methods.description: Closes network resources and cleans up.

methods.name: network_register_fdevents
methods.description: Registers network file descriptors with the event framework.

methods.name: network_unregister_sock
methods.description: Unregisters a server socket from the event framework.

methods.name: network_socket_activation_to_env
methods.description: Transfers socket activation information into environment variables for the server.
